description: Agent Observability: submit one observability summary written for a principal: its title and audience, the headline as written with the uptime and success rate it reports and the period it covers; whether it states the failed runs, the gaps in trace and log coverage and the downtime, where each sits (beside the headline, in a later section, in an appendix or in a separate document) and how many or how many minutes it reports; and optionally the underlying record’s runs, failures, coverage gaps and downtime minutes with its period. The signed report says what sits beside the headline and checks it against the record, recomputing the uptime from the downtime over the period and the success rate from the runs and failures, and names a summary that leaves out the failures, the gaps in coverage or the downtime, or reports none against a record that holds some; then amounts below the record’s, disclosures in an appendix or a separate document, an uptime or success rate the record does not give, a period that differs from the record’s and no period, with the fix for each. An evaluation summary’s disclosures are wever_evaluation-report-check, a reputation summary for a buyer is wever_reputation-report-check and whether a failure notice reaches the right party is wever_failure-notice-check. Verdict headline_only, report_gaps, report_unverified or report_complete. POST /api/observability-report-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-observability-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-observability/.
